title: Petra and the Signal
author: Hazel Pemberton
blurb: Gideon Dunmore, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
